summary: Build defensible GHG inventories, calculate Scopes 1-3, and improve reporting readiness in this five-day advanced course.
lede: GHG Protocol training helps professionals working with emissions data or operational records build structured corporate greenhouse gas inventories. Learners map organizational and operational boundaries, select and track emissions factors, calculate Scope 1 and Scope 2 emissions, and screen Scope 3 categories using activity data. They also practice spreadsheet controls, reconciliation, and evidence documentation to review inventory quality and prepare management reporting.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work with emissions data, sustainability reporting, or operational records and now need to produce a more defensible carbon accounting output.
prerequisites: Prerequisites required: Working knowledge of corporate sustainability reporting or operational data management, plus comfort with spreadsheets and basic emissions concepts. Prior exposure to the GHG Protocol Corporate Standard, ISO 14064-1:2018, or ESG reporting workflows will help, but is not mandatory for completion. No coding or programming is required; advanced concepts are taught at the operational application level, with hands-on workbook exercises rather than software engineering.
